'''2008 Louisiana State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played on Saturday 26 July 2008 at Paper Heroes, 3941 Ryan St # A, Lake Charles, Louisiana, with [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]] as tournament director.<ref name="sf-20869-301351">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=301351#p301351 Louisana States], mr007agent (Michael Richards), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (12 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125183525/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20869.html Internet Archive]</ref> Fifteen players took part. [[Brian Herold]] won and took the bye to Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship]].<ref name="sf-20869-318985">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=318985#p318985 Louisana States], The Smoking Gungan (Brian Herold), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125183525/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20869.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Paper Heroes, 3941 Ryan St # A, Lake Charles, Louisiana<ref name="sf-20869-301351" />
* '''Dates:''' 26 July 2008<ref name="sf-20869-301351" />
* '''Time:''' 10:00 am<ref name="sf-20869-301351" />
* '''Format:''' constructed Swiss, three rounds of two games (six games); card pool "Unlimited"<ref name="sf-20869-301351" />, which Richards explained as all cards with current errata and virtual cards allowed: "No cards are ever banned in this game."<ref name="sf-20869-311952">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=311952#p311952 Louisana States], mr007agent (Michael Richards), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (2 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125183525/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20869.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Entry fee:''' $5<ref name="sf-20869-301351" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]]<ref name="sf-20869-301351" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Herold]]<ref name="sf-20869-318985" />

== Organization ==

Richards posted the listing on 12 May 2008. Prizes were $50 in cash each for first place, second place and one random player, and the entry fees went to the prize pool of the [[2008 Texas State Championship|Texas State Championship]].<ref name="sf-20869-301351" /> He wrote that the listing was copied from the original post on the Decipher tournament website.<ref name="sf-20869-310428">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=310428#p310428 Louisana States], mr007agent (Michael Richards), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (27 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125183525/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20869.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Results ==

Herold, posting as The Smoking Gungan, reported the result on 29 July 2008. Fifteen people attended: Herold, three or four players from Shreveport, Louisiana, and the rest from Houston.<ref name="sf-20869-318985" />
